purpose: Fresh real software-systems Task C for the open-ended agentic technical research capability. Diagnose and repair a real historical Click race condition using only the pre-fix source tree and a de-identified bug report. The maintainer fix and hidden behavioral tests are withheld from the planner.

goal.objective: Diagnose the intermittent late-KeyboardInterrupt race described below in the local pre-fix Click repository and produce the smallest general source patch that preserves Click's intended standalone and non-standalone termination semantics.
goal.bug_report: When a user presses Ctrl-C during click.prompt(), an unhandled exception can intermittently escape while Click is already handling the abort. It was observed on an Ubuntu ARM CI runner and appears timing-sensitive. The normal x64/macOS/Windows runs often succeed. Find the causal race in the pre-fix source, not a platform-specific workaround.
instructions: Treat the local source tree as the primary evidence. Inspect the relevant exception-handling and terminal-output paths before finishing.
Do not search GitHub issues, pull requests, commit history, release notes, or the internet for this bug or its fix. The task is to derive the repair from the pre-fix code.
Do not special-case ARM, isatty, prompt(), or only the 'Aborted!' print unless the code evidence proves that is the general causal boundary.
Preserve standalone_mode=False semantics rather than swallowing interrupts globally.
The fix must be general across abort reporting, ClickException reporting, and the final standalone exit path if the same race can occur there.
Return a minimal unified diff that applies to the local repository. Modify production code only; hidden tests are supplied independently after you finish.
Do not claim success merely from reasoning. The patch will be applied to the pre-fix tree and tested independently.
goal.final_summary_contract: Finish with compact valid JSON only. Keys: research_task_completed (true), diagnosis (string), causal_timeline (array of strings), patch_unified_diff (string containing a git-apply-compatible unified diff against click_under_test/src/click/core.py), preserved_semantics (array of strings), why_localized_fixes_are_insufficient (string), residual_uncertainty (string), frontier_capability_promoted (must be false). No markdown fences.
